_comment: BADAWI Waypoint mark — raw geometry. THE single source of truth, shared by src/design/brand/mark-geometry.ts (the in-app SVG mark) and scripts/generate-brand-assets.js (app icon / favicon / splash / adaptive icon / .svg exports). Concept, element meanings, cultural-governance rationale and usage rules are documented in mark-geometry.ts and badawi-mark.tsx. Kept as JSON precisely so the icon on the home screen and the mark inside the app can never drift apart.
